literal_meaning: ছলা (deceit or trick) + কলা (art or skill); deceptive arts or tricks
figurative_meaning_en: Cunning or deceit; deceptive tactics or mannerisms to mislead or confuse the mind
similar_in_english: pull the wool over one's eyes
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ছলাকলা দেখে আমরা সত্যিকারের পরিকল্পনা বুঝতে পারিনি।
example_sentences_in_english: His tricks and deceptions made us miss the real plan.
Drop the pretense and speak directly.
note: The idiom highlights subtle manipulative behaviors common in Bengali social narratives.
